description:
Fourth item in the CI-waste sequence. A randomized generator whose destination is an issue or a known-fail file is a skip regime unless it has an owner, blocking-vs-advisory choice, seed replay, max entry age, and a staleness guard.

Nightly has no auto-revert path. This item writes the policy and any guard that enforces it. It does not add the generator job and does not change required PR lanes.

DECISION GATE: choose exactly one of ADVISORY_WITH_AGE (continue-on-error plus max age plus staleness guard) or BLOCKING_OWNED (blocking nightly job with a named owner).

anti_patterns.dont: claim a nightly generator needs no skip decision
land a generator with an unbounded known-fail file
anti_patterns.instead: require max age and a staleness guard that fails closed
anti_patterns.why: agents will add goldens and the list becomes a silent skip

preserves.behavior: Nightly remains outside post-merge auto-revert unless a later item explicitly extends EXPECTED_SIGNATURE_JOBS
